test_get_n_samples_bootstrap: test _get_n_samples_bootstrap returns n_samples when max_samples is None
test_max_samples_int: test _get_n_samples_bootstrap returns max_samples when max_samples is an integer
test_fractional_max_samples_warning: test _get_n_samples_bootstrap raises a warning when fractional max_samples produces a low number of bootstrap samples
test_weighted_sample_warning: test _get_n_samples_bootstrap raises a warning with sample weights when weighted sample count is too low
test_weighted_repeated_equivalence: test _get_n_samples_bootstrap equivalence between weighted and repeated datasets for various max_samples values
